C1632.title: NFT Collector Loses $1.5M in Assets After Wallet Private Key Leak
C1632.summary: In February 2022, NFT collector larrylawliet.eth had approximately 10.79 million RMB worth of NFTs, including Bored Ape Yacht Club and Mutant Ape Yacht Club tokens, drained from their wallet within minutes due to a private key compromise.
